where.if: AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT id, name, price, stock_quantity, image_url, description FROM products ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (name, price, stock_quantity, image_url, description) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{stockQuantity}, #{imageUrl}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET name = #{name}, price = #{price}, stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
